adds.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
adds.text: Strange and Wong save America Chavez from a demon in New York and try to protect her from Wanda at Kamar-Taj. Later, with Wong's help, Strange saves Chavez from Wanda at Mount Wundagore.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Close friend. Helps Strange protect America Chavez from Wanda.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Wong's friend. Fights beside him to protect America Chavez from Wanda.
adds.evidence: Strange rescues Chavez from a demon in New York with help from Wong, the Sorcerer Supreme; Wanda attacks Kamar-Taj and captures Wong when Strange refuses to give up Chavez; at the end, with Wong's help, Strange saves Chavez from Wanda.

none.title: Thunderbolts*
none.why: Antonia is killed by Ava in the O.X.E. vault fight early on; Alexei only arrives later to pick up Yelena, Walker and Ava, so the two never share a scene or deal with each other.

none.title: Agent Carter (One-Shot)
none.why: Dugan appears only in the mid-credits scene poolside with Howard Stark; Peggy's story is at the SSR office and the Zodiac mission, and the two never share a scene or exchange.

none.title: Iron Man
none.why: Coulson deals with Pepper and Stark in the main story; Fury appears only in the post-credits scene with Stark, and the two never share a scene, call or line about each other.
